title: KarmaChat
description: KarmaChat is a Plugin that rewards people for good words and punishes for bad words.
body:
# KarmaChat KarmaChat is a lightweight Minecraft plugin that introduces a Social Credit (Karma) system based on player's behaviour. Players are rewarded for good words and discouraged from using toxic language. The goal is simple: better chat culture through clear incentives. 🔹 Core Features: ✔ Chat-Based Karma System: Players gain +1 Social Credit for saying Good Words (like thanks, gg) Players lose -1 Social Credit when saying Bad Words.
✔ Psychological Incentive System: Encourages kindness and good behaviour. Discourages toxicity without harsh punishments.
✔ Real-Time Feedback: When someone says good words, the plugin complements them with an encouragement. When they say bad ones, the plugin tells them to refrain from being toxic.
✔ Leaderboard System: View the Top 10 People with Highest Social Credits. [ Command: /karmaleaderboard or /scleaderboard ] 🔹 Server Benefits: Improves chat quality without heavy moderation, Reduces toxicity and spam, Promotes friendliness, Works well alongside other Mod Plugins. 🔹 Why KarmaChat? Most chat moderation plugins focus on punishment. KarmaChat focuses on behavioral change. By rewarding for positivity, your server becomes: welcoming, more enjoyable, cool towards new people.
